description: Spell checker, English spelling correction suggestions. Check the spelling of English text (US and UK spellings, 274,000 words): each unknown word with its position and up to 5 suggestions. Capitalised words that are not at the start of a sentence are treated as names and skipped. Offline; the text is not stored or logged. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: spell_check
